NDT Training and Certification in Yanbu — Saudi Arabia

Atlantis NDT delivers ASNT and ISO 9712 aligned NDT training in Yanbu: Level I, Level II and Level III programmes across ultrasonic, radiographic, magnetic particle, penetrant, eddy current and visual testing, plus API 510, API 570 and API 653 inspector preparation. Courses are authored and supervised by ASNT NDT Level III professionals.

The Yanbu inspection market

Yanbu Industrial City on the Red Sea is Saudi Arabia's western oil & gas hub — home to Saudi Aramco's Yanbu Refinery, YASREF (Aramco/Sinopec JV), Petro Rabigh, and the SABIC Yanbu petrochemical complex (Yanpet, Yansab west of Jeddah). Continuous turnarounds drive demand for ASNT-certified UT, RT, PAUT and AUT technicians.

Certifications most in demand in Yanbu

Primary: ASNT. Secondary: SAEP. Also frequently requested: ISO 9712, CSWIP.

Recommended certification pathway

All Saudi Aramco facilities in Yanbu apply SAEP-1112 personnel qualification — ASNT SNT-TC-1A is the recognised compliance basis. Yanbu also has growing renewables and NEOM-region adjacent project work that increasingly accepts ISO 9712.

Delivery formats

  • Classroom cohorts with supervised practical hours logged to SNT-TC-1A requirements.
  • On-site corporate training at your facility using your equipment and specimens.
  • Blended online theory through Atlantis LMS with in-person practical assessment.
